definitions.explanation: Paint that is mixed with water rather than oil, producing translucent colors. Standard art material in Japanese schools.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{水彩|すいさい}→水彩：24163_suisai⟧ (watercolor) and {絵具|えのぐ} (paint). Watercolor painting is a standard part of the Japanese school curriculum, and nearly all elementary school students own a {水彩絵具|すいさいえのぐ}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧ (watercolor paint set).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水彩絵具|すいさいえのぐ}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: watercolor paint set
- ⟦{透明|とうめい}→透明：04565_toumei⟧{水彩絵具|すいさいえのぐ}: transparent watercolors
- ⟦{不透明|ふとうめい}→不透明：11365_futoumei⟧{水彩絵具|すいさいえのぐ}: opaque watercolors (gouache)
- {水彩絵具|すいさいえのぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{溶|と}く→溶く：26556_toku⟧: to mix watercolor paint (with water)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {油絵具|あぶらえのぐ}: oil paint — thicker, opaque, and takes longer to dry
- ⟦{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}→絵の具：16182_enogu⟧: paint (general term) — covers all types of paint for art
- ⟦{水彩画|すいさいが}→水彩画：07077_suisaiga⟧: watercolor painting — the finished work or the art form itself
